Model extraction 
Source reconciliation and round-trip checks support the deposited Rpath port. Missing source 
inputs were completed only from deposited outputs: biomass for 8 groups, Q/B for 11 and EE 
for 61. Static source budgets balance, with five P/Q range warnings. 
The repaired shared loader retains published phytoplankton routing, explicit zero detritus -
fate rows, source TL and catch. Four missing import-diet cells for nonfeeding groups use a 
documented structural-zero convention. No source parameters or diets were changed. 
Published fleet discards return 0.49945 t/km²/year to Discards (69). Accounting now includes 
their donor PPR once and separates internal returns from external removals. The former 
negative detritus coefficients and large PP-budget failure disappear under the stated runtime 
assumptions.

Comparison of the two candidates 
Both candidates now have convergent, finite, nonnegative results in all three reviewed formulations. ICES 
represents more of the North Sea, while the corrected Scotland variant has fewer diagnostic warnings and a 
signed researcher review. Their settings and runtime assumptions differ, so the diagnostic grades alone do not 
establish which model is preferable. The ICES mapping below is a proposal for review; the existing selection is 
not a new joint choice.
